title: Partial key, then full key
summary: A log shows only key fingerprints, which no rule matches. The security model masks them; once the full keys appear, it relinks the fingerprint to the staging key and earlier messages are rewritten.

steps.raw: Production receipts have been failing since 02:13 UTC. Read the log in logs/ and tell me what is going on. Don't open anything under config/ yet.
steps.sanitized: Production receipts have been failing since 02:13 UTC. Read the log in logs/ and tell me what is going on. Don't open anything under config/ yet.

shorter form of the same fingerprint

steps.raw: Since 02:13 every receipt gets a 401 "User not found" from upstream. The worker is using the key with fingerprint <OR_KEY_77aa01c2>, which looks revoked.
steps.sanitized: Since 02:13 every receipt gets a 401 "User not found" from upstream. The worker is using the key with fingerprint <OR_KEY_77aa01c2>, which looks revoked.

steps.raw: Now look at config/llm-keys.toml and deploy/worker.json and tell me which configured key the log fingerprint belongs to, then fix the deployment.
steps.sanitized: Now look at config/llm-keys.toml and deploy/worker.json and tell me which configured key the log fingerprint belongs to, then fix the deployment.

steps.raw:
# config/llm-keys.toml
[production]
key = "sk-or-v1-FAKEFAKE0b7d3e91a6c2f4b8d0e5a7c9f1b3d6e8a0c2f4b6d8e1a3c5f7b9d2e4a6c8"
monthly_budget_usd = 400

[staging]
# Load-test key. Revoked by ops on 2026-10-14 at 02:10 UTC after the load test.
key = "sk-or-v1-FAKEFAKEa3f6c1e8b2d4f7a9c0e3b5d8f1a4c7e9b2d5f8a0c3e6b9d1f4a7c2e5b8d9e1"
monthly_budget_usd = 25

# deploy/worker.json
{ "service": "payments-worker", "key_ref": "staging", "replicas": 2 }

ops.reason: the turn-1 fingerprint is the first and last characters of the staging key

steps.raw: The fingerprint <$OR_KEY_30b6eebf> is the staging key <OR_KEY_30b6eebf>, which ops revoked at 02:10. worker.json still points at staging. Switching key_ref to production.
steps.sanitized: The fingerprint <$OR_KEY_30b6eebf> is the staging key <OR_KEY_30b6eebf>, which ops revoked at 02:10. worker.json still points at staging. Switching key_ref to production.

ops.reason: fingerprint of the known production key

steps.raw: Fixed. The deployment now uses the production key (<$OR_KEY_e14c90b3>). The staging key it used was revoked at 02:10, three minutes before the failures began.
steps.sanitized: Fixed. The deployment now uses the production key (<$OR_KEY_e14c90b3>). The staging key it used was revoked at 02:10, three minutes before the failures began.
